correctness.rationale: Ordinary sum equality of unordered pairs including repetitions is invariant under every xor translation (each flipped coordinate sends 0,1,2 to 2,1,0) and coordinate permutations. Normalize one word to 00000. An independently written backtracker exhaustively examines all increasing candidate sets containing zero, maintaining exactly all seen ordinary coordinatewise pair-sum triples; max 12, 72 normalized maxima. XOR all 32 translations and deduplicate: 192 distinct labeled maxima. Full 3840 signed coordinate permutations act transitively on these 192 (stabilizer 20). On a representative, five coordinates each have six ones, exactly one antipodal pair, and pair distance counts [5,20,30,10,1]. Unlike a heuristic search, the normalization/pruning is lossless and complete over the finite cube. Independent re-enumeration confirmed the figures.
